headline: 134 piece(s) of work remain — 10 product, 36 evidence, 88 decision — across 620 ledger rows. This reckoning speaks for 99% of the campaign's designed cases and 70% of its stated requirements; the rest is not known to be done, it is simply not known. 80 brief(s) could not be tied to the registry at all; they are listed as `unjoined` and counted as decision work, rather than assumed unbuilt.

cases_adjudicated.means: an instrument returned a verdict on the product — pass or fail. A fail is knowledge; this is not a pass rate.

decisions_taken.means: somebody ruled the cell out of scope or not applicable. A decision, not a measurement, and it is kept out of the line above on purpose.

requirements_observed.means: somebody watched it happen, rather than the project reporting it of itself.

surfaces_spoken_for.means: at least one case on this surface reached a verdict.

briefs_joined.means: the brief could be tied to something in the registry at all.

notes: Taken at wave 16's close-in-progress rather than after it: PRO-0101 had not merged when this was read, so its REQ-100/101, CASE-0430-0440, DEF-215 and SURF-024 are not in this tree.
